features: Moves Archive Event management to the main Admin Dashboard where event lifecycle controls belong
Adds an Archive Event quick action and dashboard event table showing active events, dates, statuses and scoring-round counts
Dashboard archive actions preserve the event, registrations, competitors, scoring data, results and points while removing the event from active scoring/projector workflows
Archive requests return directly to the Admin Dashboard after completion
Uses the existing bdc_scoring_archived_events registry introduced in dev120 and does not change bdc_events.status
Keeps authenticated admin access, CSRF validation and confirmation protection
Includes the dev119 migration-version capacity fix
No Staging or Production deployment performed
